prompt_text: Use the attached ORIGINAL source contact sheet, not any prior generated sheet. Six objects in source reading order correspond exactly to six rows. Return a transparent orthographic atlas exactly six columns × six rows: FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. The center-dot guide only indicates cells; do not reproduce dots. Preserve all original geometry, material, color and details. This correction requires true axis-aligned world projections: no three-quarter or isometric camera; front/rear are opposite broad elevations and right/left are exact 90-degree perpendicular elevations. Use a consistent vertical Z height in every elevation; no view may change the object's height or unit size. ROW 1 bridge: the deck is a flat square plank platform on four corner posts. FRONT/REAR show a broad, straight horizontal deck edge with four supports all at the same Z height; RIGHT/LEFT show the perpendicular edge with same exact vertical post height. Never show the diamond-shaped isometric deck in any elevation. TOP is the square plank deck footprint. BOTTOM looks straight up and shows the square underside beam grid/support pattern flat-on, no perspective and no visible side faces. ROW 2 barred gate: FRONT/REAR are flat-on gate faces; RIGHT and LEFT are true 90-degree edge-on views, showing only one narrow vertical gate thickness, never an angled view with the pickets visible. Keep already-correct thin TOP/BOTTOM edge views. ROW 3 stairs: FRONT is the exact straight-on rising step profile; RIGHT is the perpendicular end-on vertical slab face; LEFT opposite end-on slab; REAR is one flat plain vertical back wall; BOTTOM one flat rectangular underside slab. Keep source step count and same Z-height/scale. ROW 4 L-wall: exact L-shaped two-wing stone wall; TOP/BOTTOM retain L footprint. Each wing has exactly two block courses (same Z height). FRONT/REAR and RIGHT/LEFT each show a flat-on broad elevation of its respective wing, each exactly two block-courses high and same projected height; do not show the L corner diagonally or make the lateral view taller. ROW 5 pillar: keep its original-source flat single-face front/rear, adjacent flat single-face right/left, square top and bottom. ROW 6 barricade: keep coherent original geometry. Keep one complete centered object per cell with transparent background; no text, labels, grid, borders, shadow, scene, duplicate, clipping or neighboring-object leakage. Unseen surfaces remain conservative inferred views, not recovered pixels.
